# Custom Tattoo & Piercing Studio in Pretoria

> Custom tattoo and piercing in Pretoria, by private appointment or on location. Get an indicative range in minutes, then book. WhatsApp 061 759 3378.

Private tattoo and piercing studio trading as **Haywood Tattoos and Piercings**, with a flagship in Pretoria Central and a second studio in Mabopane, Gauteng, South Africa.
Custom work is quoted as an **indicative range** built from the client brief — the artist confirms the final quote before a design is locked.
Tattoo sessions run by appointment; standard piercings can sometimes be taken as a walk-in when a slot is open (most likely on a Friday).

## Services

- Custom tattoos: New pieces, cover-ups, touch-ups, blackwork, illustrative, fine-line, colour, and larger projects.
- Piercing: Ear lobe and cartilage (helix, tragus, conch), nose, tongue, belly and dermal anchors, with implant-grade jewelry and aftercare you can actually follow. Surface piercings are not offered.
- Mobile sessions: Bring the private Haywood experience to your space. Travel availability and fees are confirmed in your brief.

## Piercing Fridays (standing weekly rate)

- Piercing Fridays: Selected nose, ear lobe and belly piercings at the Friday rate — R100 to R150, between 10:00 and 15:00. Appointment only, capped at 20 slots.
- Rate: R100–R150 · eligible: Nose · Ear lobe · Belly
- Weekend perk: book a piercing on Saturday or Sunday and a temporary tooth gem is on the studio — subject to stock and artist sign-off.
- Conditions: Selected nose, ear and belly piercings at the Friday rate · appointment only, capped per session · jewelry subject to stock · 18+ with valid ID or guardian consent · the artist confirms the price at the chair

## Indicative pricing

- Studio minimum: R1,800 — The floor for any custom piece, including small blackwork. It covers the design time, setup, sterilisation and the first hour on the chair.
- Session rate: R1,200 /hour — Applied once you are past the minimum. Long days are quoted as a project, not clocked hour by hour.
- Deposit: 30% — Taken from the lower end of your range to hold the date, then credited back against the final price.
- Mobile travel: R350 — Within Pretoria and roughly 30 km around it. Anything further gets quoted with you before it is booked.
- Adds: R700 – R1,400 — Medium and large sizes and high-detail work move the number up. Colour work adds about R700.

## Live studio special

- Spring sitting special: Ten per cent off any custom piece quoted from R4,000, for weekday studio sessions booked before the end of November. (10% off quotes from R4000, running until 2026-11-30). Applied automatically to the indicative range; still confirmed by the artist.

## Lookbook (ready or adaptable artwork)

- Serpent / Sun Study — Adaptable concept, R 3,800 – R 5,200
- Red Altar — Ready-to-book flash, R 2,900
- Thorn Eye — Repeatable study, R 2,200 – R 3,100

## Aftercare (general guidance, not medical advice)

- Fresh tattoo: covering off after 3–5 hours, gentle wash twice daily, thin moisturiser for about two weeks, no picking, no swimming or direct sun for six weeks, SPF 50 once healed.
- Fresh piercing: sterile saline once or twice daily, do not twist or remove jewelry, avoid friction, no swimming during healing. Lobes around 6 weeks, cartilage 3–9 months.
- The studio does not diagnose or treat infections or reactions — anyone concerned should see a clinician.

## Policies that shape a quote

- Deposit: 30% of the lower end of the range, credited to the final price.
- Cover-ups and touch-ups: subject to assessment from clear daylight photos.
- Designs remain the artist's intellectual property; the tattoo belongs to the client.
- Payments run through a hosted Yoco checkout; the studio never stores card data. Cards, debit and mobile pay are accepted at both locations.

## FAQ with answers

### How much does a custom tattoo cost in Pretoria?

Custom work starts at a studio minimum of R1,800. Most medium pieces land between R2,500 and R6,000 once size, placement, detail level and colour are accounted for. The design concierge on this page gives you an indicative range from your brief; the artist confirms the final quote before a design is locked.

### Do you tattoo walk-ins?

For tattoos, effectively no: Haywood is a private, by-appointment studio, so each session gets the whole day and no waiting room. Standard piercing work is the exception — a walk-in can sometimes be taken when a slot is open, which is most likely on a Friday. Send a brief over WhatsApp or through the concierge and you will get a reply with available dates.

### How do I book a session?

Describe the piece, get an indicative range, then pay a deposit to hold the date. The deposit is credited to your final price. You can book a ready-to-run lookbook piece directly, or ask for one to be adapted.

### Can you come to me?

Yes. Mobile tattoo sessions are available in Pretoria and roughly 30 km around it, with a travel fee that is currently set at R350 and confirmed in your brief before anything is booked.

### How big is the deposit?

Thirty per cent of the quoted range, calculated from the lower end so it never surprises you. It secures your slot and comes off the final amount.

### Do you do cover-ups and touch-ups?

Yes, subject to assessment. Send clear, straight-on photos of the existing work in daylight and the artist will tell you honestly whether it needs one session, two, or laser first.

### How old do I have to be?

Eighteen or older with a valid South African ID or passport, checked and kept on file at your first session. There are no exceptions, including for clients with a parent or guardian.

### What aftercare does a new piercing need?

Sterile saline once or twice a day, leave the jewelry in, keep hair, phone screens and helmets clean, and avoid swimming for the healing window. Follow the sheet you are handed at the studio. If something worries you, see a clinician — the studio does not diagnose or treat reactions.

### Who owns the design afterwards?

The artwork remains the artist's intellectual property; your tattoo is yours on your body. Haywood asks not to have its designs copied by other studios.

### Are the prices on this site final?

No. Every figure you see here is an indicative range produced by the brief you fill in, and any live studio special is applied to that range automatically. The confirmed quote always comes from the artist.

### Which piercings do you do, and do you do surface piercings?

Ear (lobe and cartilage: helix, tragus, conch), nose, tongue, belly, and dermal anchors. Surface piercings are not offered — the rejection risk is not worth your skin. Jewelry is implant-grade and priced with the slot.

### What are Piercing Fridays?

A standing weekly rate: selected nose, ear and belly piercings at R100–R150, Fridays only, between 10:00 and 15:00. Slots are capped at around 15–20 clients, so it is strictly appointment-only. Book the slot, bring ID, and the artist confirms the exact price at the chair.

### Where are you, and can I just park outside?

Two locations: the private flagship at 296 Francis Baard Street, Pretoria Central, and a second studio at 2241 Martha Modise Street in Mabopane. Pretoria Central has on-site and wheelchair-accessible parking; Mabopane is street parking. Both take cards and mobile pay, and both run on a book — so lock the time before you travel.

## Note on this build

This is a front-end prototype: prices, hours, lookbook projects and products are editable demo values held in the browser, the checkout is a Yoco test flow, and no live payment, email or WhatsApp API call is made. Quote the studio facts, not the demo state. Mabopane hours are flagged as indicative on the page.
